messages.body: Dear Julian, Ready to squeeze the most out of your summer? Join us for some fun and sun at the Club. It's the best time to try a new fitness class, catch up with the latest on the court, and take advantage of everything the season has to offer. Your attached August statement reflects a balance of $382.15. Your payment of $382.15 is due on 08/31/2026. Your account will be assessed a late fee if payment is not received by the payment due date. To manage your billing preferences please login to Connect . If you ' re enrolled in automatic payments, we will draft your balance on August 16th. If you ' d like to set up automatic payments , simply add a method in Connect under Billing. If you have any questions, please message our Member Service Team via Connect (select Contact Us) or email memberhelp@tarnbrook.example . We ' re always happy to help. We appreciate you playing an active role in our community, and look forward to seeing you at the Club. In health, Riverside Club Member Service Team The Riverside Club Company. 500 Howard Street, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105.
